name: type
eval: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.persona-modal textarea'); if (!ta) return 'NO_TA'; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(ta, '【身份】你是矩阵发布官（测试自定义人设）。\n【输出】每次交付一张发布排期表，含平台、时间、素材链接、责任人四列。\n【红线】不在非工作时段发布，不发布未审核素材。'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'SET:' + ta.value.length; })()

name: verify-ui
eval: (() => { return JSON.stringify({ modalClosed: !document.querySelector('.persona-modal'), toast: document.querySelector('.toast, [class*=toast]')?.textContent || '', badge: document.querySelector('.agent-persona-badge')?.textContent?.trim() || 'NO_BADGE' }); })()
